title: Trace candidate EUR substitution callback text sources
changes: Identify the text selector paths of a frequently occurring declared substitution candidate and reconcile them with existing authenticated catalogs.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-candidate-callbacks-dis-wine-nxd4bals and e158-byte00-callback28-selectors-dis-wine-6zw8vl88 inspect the original callback and selector branches.
Previously accepted Wine e132-byte00-textscan-78suaoix found no target sequence in expanded strings of the authenticated catalog; no scan was repeated.
limitations: The original live ten-bit and halfword indices are not constrained to the catalog, and 080d2588 derives additional indices from live state. Candidate opcode occurrences do not prove execution; other callbacks, generated sources and ordinary byte00 use remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
